# Notebooks

**These files are build output. Do not edit them directly.**

They are generated by `tools/build_notebooks.py`, which holds the content for
all four in one place:

```bash
python tools/build_notebooks.py     # regenerate
python tools/check_notebooks.py     # execute and report failures
```

The reason for the indirection: NB1/NB2 and NB-SOLUTIONS come from the *same*
source functions, with a `sol=True` flag filling in every live-code cell and
every `___` blank. The solutions therefore cannot drift out of sync with the
exercises, which is the failure that makes a solutions notebook worse than
useless. CI fails the build if a committed `.ipynb` does not match the
generator.

| Notebook | Covers |
|---|---|
| `NB0-warmup.ipynb` | Pre-work. ~10 cells, read-and-run only, no blanks. |
| `NB1-python-data.ipynb` | 0:00–0:55. Section headers, empty live-code cells, scaffolded exercises. |
| `NB2-machine-learning.ipynb` | 1:00–2:00. **Loads its own clean dataframe in cell 1.** |
| `NB-SOLUTIONS.ipynb` | Every blank filled, with comments. Released at the end. |
